notes: Daily/total yield (grid + PV1 + PV2) now always published as retained MQTT messages regardless of the mqttRetain setting, so a reconnecting client (e.g. the PWA) sees last-known yield even if the inverter has been offline a while. Fixed browser autofill incorrectly populating the WiFi/MQTT/web-GUI password fields (autocomplete=
added). Grid/PV1/PV2 dashboard cards now share one power-tiered color scale (<250W cyan, <500W purple, else pink) instead of PV1/PV2 having no dedicated coloring, matching the PWA.
